name: cruise
description: Evidence-attested Goal execution with adaptive quality profiles.

interface.longDescription: Cruise compiles intent into evidence-bound quality Flights and milestone queues, then supervises native Goal progress without replacing Codex permissions or approvals.
defaultPrompt: Use $cruise:build to plan a new project or major milestone.
Use $cruise:goal to plan and carry out a finite feature or larger migration.
Use $cruise:goal for a read-only repository-aware plan when planning only is explicit.
